name: Arantor

alignment.name: Chaotic Evil
alignment.description:
Chaotic evil creatures have a complete disregard for others. They kill, steal, and betray others to gain power. Their word is meaningless and their actions destructive. Their worldviews can be so warped that they destroy anything and anyone that doesn’t directly contribute to their interests.
	By the standards of good and lawful good people, chaotic evil is as abhorrent as evil, perhaps even more so. Chaotic evil monsters such as demons and orcs are at least as much of a threat to civilization and general well-being as evil monsters are. An evil creature and a chaotic evil creature are both opposed to good, but they don’t have much respect for each other either and rarely cooperate toward common goals.
	For the purpose of game effects, a chaotic evil creature is also considered evil.

description: Creatures larger than Medium take up more than 1 square. For instance, an ogre takes up a space that is 2 squares by 2 squares. Most Large and larger creatures also have a reach greater than 1, which means they can make melee attacks against creatures that aren’t adjacent to them. A creature’s basic body shape usually determines its reach; a Large ogre has a reach of 2, but a Large horse has a reach of 1.

traits.name: Two Souls
traits.details: Arantor acts twice each round, once on initiative result 30 and once on initiative result 20. The first is Arantor’s turn, and the second is Imrissa’s turn, which determines which powers Arantor can use on each turn. On Imrissa’s turn, Arantor can only move by using dead dragon’s stride.

effect.description: Arantor makes a claw attack against each enemy in reach, and one bite attack.

hit.description: necrotic damage, and the target takes 15 ongoing cold damage (save ends)

effect.description: Arantor recharges remnant breath and uses it immediately;

hit.description: psychic damage and the target is dazed until it damages one of its allies

powers.name: Influential Whispers
powers.description: The nearest ally within 3 squares of the target is dominated (save ends). This attack does not provoke opportunity attacks

hit.description: psychic damage, and the target is dominated (save ends).

aftereffects.name: Aftereffect
aftereffects.description: The nearest ally within 3 squares of the target is dominated (save ends). This attack does not provoke opportunity attacks

powers.name: Shattered Prison
powers.trigger: when Arantor drops to 0 or fewer hit points

effect.description: Arantor’s corpse cracks open and releases Imrissa, who continues to fight. She is large instead of huge, has 234 hit points, does not benefit from two souls, can move normally, and only uses powers that can be used on Imrissa’s turn.
